fullPassage: We are living in the age of connectivity driven by the permeating and relatively inexpensive and proliferated wireless broadband, fastest-growing mobile technology, and social media mediated peer-to-peer communication. As a result, marketing is changing with the power of authentic, relevant, and experiential storytelling. Social media is shifting the power from marketers to consumers where the stories told by the consumers themselves are often more potent than the ones told by the brands. Authentic storytelling does not use rational and emotional communication as a means of manipulation; instead, it uses the power of storytelling honestly and sincerely to connect with the customer at a deeper level. Authentic storytelling invites customers on a transformational journey through a rational message wrapped in emotion. "A well-told story captures our attention, holds us in suspense, and pays off with a meaningful emotional experience." A well-told brand story uses characters through whose eyes the customer can see the world and be empathetic for the character. Customers therefore can relate to the character. Through demonstrating the day-to-day life challenges of their customers, strong brands hold their hands as a mentor rather than the hero.

A well-told brand story uses characters through whose eyes the customer can see the world and be empathetic for the character. Customers therefore can relate to the character. Through demonstrating the day-to-day life challenges of their customers, strong brands hold their hands as a mentor rather than the hero.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 transformational와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: transformational(변화를 일으키는) ↔ static(변화 없는, 정적인).
det.analysis:
❌ ① colorful — 다채로운 (의미축 다름: 색)
❌ ② distant — 멀리 있는 (의미축 다름: 거리)
✅ ③ static — 변화 없는, 정적인 (반의어) ←정답
❌ ④ expensive — 비싼 (의미축 다름: 가격)
det.tip: transformational(변화를 일으키는) ↔ static(변화 없는)

questions.passage:
(A) The novel's main <u>character</u> is a young girl who survives alone on a deserted island.

(B) Honesty and courage are the most important parts of a person's <u>character</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 character의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) the main character = (소설 속) 등장인물 / (B) a person's character = 성격, 인격.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 등장인물 — 성격, 인격 ←정답
❌ ② 성격, 인격 — 등장인물 (A와 B가 뒤바뀜)
❌ ③ 등장인물 — 글자, 문자 (B는 '글자'가 아니라 '성격')
❌ ④ 글자, 문자 — 성격, 인격 (A는 '글자'가 아니라 '등장인물')
det.tip: character: (A) 등장인물 vs (B) 성격/인격

det.analysis:

questions.passage: We are living in the age of connectivity __________ (drive) by the fastest-growing mobile technology and social media mediated peer-to-peer communication. As a result, marketing is changing with the power of authentic and experiential storytelling.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 명사 connectivity를 뒤에서 꾸미는 자리로, '~에 의해 이끌어진'이라는 수동의 의미이므로 drive를 과거분사 driven으로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: the age of connectivity __________ (drive) by ... → connectivity가 무선 기술 '에 의해 이끌어지는' 대상이므로 「과거분사 + by」 수동 형태 → drive를 driven으로
det.tip: 명사 + 과거분사(driven) + by = ~에 의해 이끌어진 (수동 수식)

questions.passage: Authentic storytelling invites customers on a transformational journey through a rational message wrapped in emotion. A well-told story captures our attention, holds us in suspense, and __________ (pay) off with a meaningful emotional experience.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 주어 A well-told story(단수)에 captures, holds와 나란히 이어지는 세 번째 동사 자리로, 병렬·수 일치에 따라 pay를 pays로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: A well-told story captures ..., holds ..., and __________ (pay) off → 단수 주어 story에 대한 세 동사 병렬(captures/holds/pays), 현재시제 3인칭 단수 → pay를 pays로
det.tip: 단수 주어 + 동사 병렬: captures, holds, pays (수 일치)
